messages:
maya: Heads-up: planning TLS cert rotation for prod next Tue 03/24 02:00 UTC. Quick checklist: 1) confirm TLS versions we want allowed (we currently enforce 1.3 on LB but backends allow 1.2), 2) who actually has private-key access, 3) will rotated certs or CSRs leak into logs? ping @kevin @olivia
kevin: We do enforce TLSv1.3 termination at the GCLB layer already. Backends have 1.2 fallback for legacy clients. For rotation I suggest making M→TLSv1.3-only for prod after a short canary in staging.
olivia: Confirming key ownership: private keys are managed by GCP KMS (HSM-backed) under project `redwood-prod-kms`. The cert-rotator service account `redwood-cert-rotator@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com` performs the rotation via in-cloud signing. Human/ops export is blocked. Human access requires a request to the `hsm-admins` group.
hsm-admin: Correct — no human export permitted. Rotations are done by cert-rotator which generates a CSR and KMS signs the cert. If someone needs temporary approval to perform emergency ops, open ticket INC-4725 with justification; access is time-bound.
sam: On logs: load balancer and cert-rotator emit fingerprints and certificate CNs to `loadbalancer-audit` and `infra-audit` indices. We do NOT log PEM bodies. I'll add an explicit redaction filter to fluentd to be safe. Example filter I plan to add:
```
<filter **>
  @type record_transformer
  <record>
    message ${record["message"].gsub(/-----BEGIN (CERTIFICATE|PRIVATE KEY)-----[\s\S]*?-----END (CERTIFICATE|PRIVATE KEY)-----/, "[REDACTED PEM]")}
  </record>
</filter>
```
security-bot: Reminder/checklist: add redaction rule to `infra-logging` repo, add a unit test to the logging CI to assert no PEM tokens, and update retention policy doc.
maya: Thanks. kevin — can you run the staging canary and open a PR to infra-runbooks with the rotation steps + HSM ownership notes?
kevin: Yup. I'll open a PR this afternoon. Staging canary scheduled Wed 03/22 19:00 UTC. Canaries: order is staging LB -> staging backends -> run smoke tests -> prod LB rolling restarts.
infra-bot: rotation-job created: `rot-job-175850` scheduled 2026-03-24T02:00:00Z, owner `kevin`, canary window 30m.
maya: One more: make sure we test client compatibility (curl/openssl checks). Quick test command: `openssl s_client -connect lb.redwood.com:443 -tls1_3` and nginx config snippet to enforce TLSv1.3 only:
```
ssl_protocols TLSv1.3;
ssl_prefer_server_ciphers on;
```
olivia: I'll attach the KMS key resource names and the IAM binding in the PR so SRE knows which service accounts to expect.
maya: :thumbsup: marking this blocked pending approval on INC-4725 from `hsm-admins`. If anyone sees gaps shout here.
